references.text: The original instruction for the construction of the lampstand, where its knobs and branches were to be one piece with it, hammered out of pure gold.
God's command to make the lampstand of pure gold, of hammered work, as Exodus 37:22 describes the fulfillment of.
The beginning of the description of the making of the lampstand, where the same expression 'hammered work of pure gold' is used.
Confirms that the lampstand was made as hammered work of gold, in accordance with the pattern the Lord showed Moses.
Hebrews mentions the lampstand as part of the holy place in the tabernacle, pointing to the Old Testament system of worship.
